name: meeras
description: Meeras Islamic Will WebApp: single-file static site; the tests slice the farāʾiḍ engine out of index.html

scripts.deploy:prod: npm test && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm test && npm run build:staging && npx --yes wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.dev:api: node build.js --env staging && npx --yes wrangler dev --env staging --local --port 8787
